column2: Something slowly flexes under the translucent shell — yearning for the brood nest's warmth. Away from the nest its life slowly fades until it becomes nothing but nourishment.\nThe little life inside is searching for the right food; different things stir it in different ways.\nPerhaps try laying liquids or things that look like liquids upon it?
An egg that never took. Nothing but thick nourishment left in the shell — still a decent meal.
A little tentacle freshly out of its shell — still wet and wriggling. Put it in the brood nest's nursery and feed it until it grows.
A seedling that didn't make it — limp but still edible. Lay it on a host being devoured and the body accepts it as a substitute; loosening its grip so you can move her out.
A crystal that sometimes condenses as a host is devoured. The body stirs in its presence; it seems it could change the body in some irreversible way?
A big intact piece of tentacle, still faintly clenching. A knife splits it into 2 medium chunks.
Cut tentacle meat. A knife splits it into 2 small chunks.
A small piece of tentacle meat, still oozing at the cut.
...Can't digest that yet. (Devouring hosts and absorbing tentacles unlock once the nest awakens.)
The door... it's open? What is all this slime...
You... you're not human! Open fire! FIRE!
[Brood] Carrying eggs: night {0}/{1} · lays in {2} more night(s) (about {3})
[Brood] Resting after laying: {0} more night(s) before she can carry eggs again
Next step: yellow tentacle secretion bonus ≥{0}%
Fully devoured in about {0} more night(s) (a failed seedling pauses it)
...{0} already today. The body is still digesting. Tomorrow.
A grown tentacle from an older version. It is converted to the matching coloured tentacle on load.
A pink-gleaming white tentacle so plump that a light press dents it. It's the meat the nest grows — eat it as is or take a knife to cut it into chunks.

A muscle-bound crimson tentacle radiating raw strength. Its lash could crack stone; its dubious shape might draw inspection.\nIt seems to hunger for the outside — bonded to you it helps scavenging and improves the odds of a catch.\nIt couples with hosts directly and can be cut for meat.

A deep-green tentacle with bark-rough hide — strung tight with grit; pull all you like and it won't tear. Clearly not something for the counter.\nBonded to you; scavenging goes smoother and hurts less.\nIt has its own way with hosts; and it can be cut for meat.

A yellow tentacle bristling with glands — always seeping a slick liquid with a faint sickly-sweet scent.\nBonded to you; the hosts grow fuller and their milk turns richer.\nIt has its own way with hosts; and it can be cut for meat.

A breathing pale-blue tentacle — always misted with water; its body a living waterskin. It seems to wring water from the air and slowly cleans what it stores.\nBonded to you; that water quietly tops up the brood nest. It is gentler with hosts; and it can be cut for meat.

A thin sensitive purple tentacle whose tips twitch in the air as if listening.\nBonded to you; hosts conceive more easily. Keep three of a kind and the shop fills with a faint sweet scent that makes customers agreeable.\nIt holds a quiet sway over hosts; and it can be cut for meat.
The crystal Li Beiwen brought. Something inside you warms when you're near it.

The thing that grew out of you — fused with the crystal into a living nest. It is divided into chambers; one feeds and hatches; one raises the young; another stores water and yields produce; and the last is for the tentacles that share your body.
The chamber that eats and hatches. Food placed on its left is digested overnight into the nest's stores; eggs on the right are fed from those stores.
The nest's soft water organ. Press a bottle or a blue tentacle to it to pour water in; the young drink from it every night.
The chamber kept for grown tentacles. Place them inside and they will rejoin your body; each lending its own gift.
Little balls of tentacle chunk and starch. Crisp outside, tender inside, and now and then it twitches on your tongue.
Salted tentacle meat grilled on a skewer until smoky. Plenty of chew.
A whole tentacle steak baked under bubbling cheese; the suckers trail strings of it when you cut in.
Instant noodles with a respectable name: fish and tentacle tossed through. Suspiciously fresh.
When you open for the morning, you find an unsigned note pushed under the door. A few tentacle recipes are scrawled across it:
At the bottom is a sketch of a cooking pot and one tentacle curled upward for no obvious reason.

Your place smelled strongly last night. It seems you've undergone a certain change in life as well.

Be careful not to let yourself grow too hungry. Humans are hardly friendly to our kind.

The scrapyard is a good place, but mind the noise. Press yourself over them and coil around them; swallow slowly. While they enjoy it, their voices will not carry beyond you.

Raising offspring is never easy. Besides common drinks and liquids, try livestock medicines and chemical fluids.

Liquefied fat, a large amount of highly pure water, and perfume are choices too. What sort of offspring they raise is harder to say. Listen closely when you interact with the eggs wrapped around your young. And remember: offspring are part of the nourishment cycle too.

You should know how to devour by now. Spread yourself over them, then slowly draw them into your sac...
This nest hasn't fully come alive yet. Lay it on the brood core crystal and it will drink it in.
The thin shell slowly swells and eases with the life inside.
A faint, trembling pulse from inside. It's alive.
Press a fingertip to it and something nudges back from the other side.
The shell is warm, a little warmer than skin.
Through the shell, a shadow slowly turns over.
It seems to be waiting for something. Maybe for you.
You listen closely. Through the bond of flesh, you sense something.
It rests hollow against your palm, as if waiting for something to be laid upon its shell.
The shell opens and closes faintly. Perhaps you should set different things on it and let it choose.
A dry scraping comes from within. A container filled with the right sort of liquid... perhaps it would like that.
Anything. Let me taste it first
Warm. Rich. Like blood and flesh
Bitter. Living. Medicine and the taste of decay
Sweet. Strong. Fat and sharp-smelling things
Water. Much clean water. And a cold chemical taste
Fragrance. Dreams. Things that make nerves tingle
Empty belly. The movement inside grows fainter
Too many voices, crowded together, almost tearing each other apart
Only just settled. Still curled up and unwilling to wake
Awake. Slowly. Still feeling along the edge of the shell
The shadow inside already follows your finger
The shell grows thinner. It is already looking for a way out
It looks full already. It doesn't need any more.
It drinks greedily — but not enough. It still wants more.
The shell drinks it in... nothing happens. This liquid doesn't seem to do anything.
The shell drinks it in. The shadow inside pauses, then starts growing anew.
The shell flinches. The shadow inside scatters and gathers again... the mutation didn't take and hatching starts over. It does look plumper, though.
The shadow inside changes shape. It will grow into the {0} line.
It's had enough for today. Try again tomorrow.
The body lets go of {0} and wraps around the seedling instead. Devouring paused; she can be moved out now.
{0} reaches the strongest climax of her life... and becomes part of the tentacles.
{0}'s voice fades bit by bit until only a contented sigh is left... she has been taken in completely.
The tentacles close. When they unfurl again, {0} is no longer there.
The body swallows it. {0} genes Lv{1}.
The body swallows it and something inside rearranges. {0} genes rose to Lv{1}!
The body can't take it yet. Reach Lv5 first.
The body is at its peak and can't absorb any more.
...Condensed. Offspring. Left by the host. A blessing.
...Names. Memories. Melted. All of it. Ours.
...Grow. Grow more. The nest. Goes deeper.
The body broke through to Lv{0}! Free adaptation points: {1}. Spend them under "Body adaptation" in the brood nest.
Metabolism {0}/{1}: food and water use -3% per point (max -60% with the devour reduction)
No free points, or this one is maxed.
Extra outputs per host +{0} (best one counts) - secretion value +{1}% (stacks)
Collects {0} ml water a day - filters {1} ml of impurities
Egg conception +{0}% (stacks) - 3 deployed unlock Brood Fragrance

{0} ate its fill and grew a size.
The child in {0}'s womb mutated. It is a clutch of tentacle eggs now.
A brood essence condensed where she was.
{0} egg(s) were unfertilized and became nutrient eggs.
{0} egg(s) failed to hatch, leaving only a withered seedling.
It seems to have a preferred food already...
Some tentacle eggs could not withstand mutation from too many gene branches and died within their shells...
{0} egg(s) starved in the shell, leaving only a seedling.
{0} larva(e) grew up: {1}. Placed in the output area.
Not enough food in the nest; {0} went hungry.
The water nest is dry; {0} larva(e) stopped growing.
{0} larva(e) went dry too long and shriveled. They are shrinking back.
Not in a hatching area: becomes a nutrient egg in {0} night(s)
Set in shape; won't take more liquid
{0} line - growing {1}% - starts at Lv0 when grown
At the cap: body {0} genes are Lv{1}; raise the gene to keep growing
Lv0: symbiotic ability not active yet; feed it to reach Lv1
Lv{0}/{1} - exp {2}/{3} (feed it to level up)
Drag the Tentacle Body onto it to absorb it for this branch's gene exp
Can be used on a host today ({0}% chance to grow her chest one size, {1}% chance her figure matures one step)
Can be used on a host today
Once the nest opens, cover a girl with the body and you can take her in, becoming wholly one.
The nest only opens once the body has grown past its initial form. (Requires Lv{0})
And when the tentacle's seed fluid spills out into the world, it may draw something here.
Inner state: nest not yet open
Brood Lv{0} - devoured {1} - hungry {2} night(s) in a row
Fed back by what the body has devoured: egg and larva growth +{0}% ({1} actively devoured; +{3}% per {2}, max +{4}%)
No feedback from the body yet. Every {2} individuals it actively devours speed up egg and larva growth by +{3}% (max +{4}%)
Equip the body and click a host, or drag the body onto her: devour her. Drag a grown tentacle onto the body: absorb its genes.
Base nightly chance for a host to conceive eggs. x2 when ovulating, x3 while being devoured. Default 12%.
When the base mod rolls a human pregnancy, the chance it mutates into an egg pregnancy. Default 30%.
Chance to get infected the night after scavenging. Defaults: major 30%, minor 15%, unhurt 5%.
White tentacle: chance to grow chest one size (%)
Chance that using a white tentacle on a host grows her chest tag one step (flat -> average -> large). Only grows. Default 12%, range 1-80%.
White tentacle: chance her figure matures one step (%)

Chance that using a white tentacle on a host matures her figure one step (loli -> girl -> lady -> young wife -> mature). Only advances among adult categories, stopping at mature. Default 10%, range 0-100% (0 = off).
Something feels off with your body... that wound still hasn't closed.
The skin around the wound runs hotter, and twitches on its own now and then.
Something is moving under your skin. It's growing deeper.
Infection: first sign at tonight's end of day
You wake up no longer entirely human. Gained the perk [Tentacle Origin]; a [Tentacle Body] of your own is in your inventory.
...Human? Right, I'm still pretending to be one.
Wait, why am I like this? Oh... I think I've turned into tentacles.
Your body feels like it's splitting down the middle.
Your stomach heaves; your throat clenches again and again.
You double over and bring up something warm and writhing.
The offshoot crawls to the core crystal and wraps itself around it.
Before dawn, a nest has grown there.
By the time you come back to yourself, day {0} is already gone.
The shop is a mess, slime trails everywhere.
We have reports of a heavy stench coming from this place!
Enforcers broke down the door. They never found the owner, only a whole room of writhing nest and what it hadn't finished digesting. Afterwards, the shop's number was struck from the station records.
Hello, sorry to bother you. I'm Li Beiwen. I do a bit of research down on the lower levels.
I'm not here to sell information today. I have something I think belongs with you.
We meet again. I hope our last deal went well for you?
This time I haven't brought information. I've brought something... more troublesome.
Relax, I'm not here to settle scores. They held me a few days, got nothing, and let me go.
Honestly, I didn't much want to come back here. But you're the only one I could think to give this to.
Hello again. The crystal... have you thought it over?
It's been growing faster lately. I'm running out of room for it.
A while back I found a crystal in a lower-level scrap heap and spent half a month studying it.
No readable composition, a spectrum that matches nothing. As research material it's practically a rock.
Then a neighbour walked past my bench wearing a perfume I hear came from your shop. The crystal moved. It grew towards her.
I don't know what you're selling and won't ask. But I think it's more use to you than to me.
Still, it's a precious specimen and my research needs funding. {0} credits, no haggling.
Thank you. With you, I think it's finally where it belongs.
Oh, and it reacts very strongly to your scent.
I need to think it over.
All right. It'll keep growing... I'll come back in a few days.
I'll be going then. Good luck with... business.

Cargo. Hoard. Accumulate. Mm. Trade. Food.
Black market. Dark meat. All good.
Look. Picture. Do not touch. We touch.
Hungry. Empty. Gone. Host. Gone. Gone.
Hungry. Thirst-hunger. Host. Join. Devour. Join. Craving. Craving, unbearable.
Hun-hun-hungry! Craving, craving! Host! Devour. Devour. Host! Join. Join. Must! Join.
Outside. Abandoned. Hidden. Human, food, food. ...Want.
Quiet. Abandoned. Trash. Human, someone. Mother-body, host. ...Craving. ...Craving!
Humans, will not go. Glrk, glrk. Humans, do not want. Dirty. Kak-kak-kak. But, host. Offspring, breed. Needed.
Cover. Self-body, mother-body. Tentacle-body, host. Cover, proper. Host, changing. Forever, gift.
Mother-body, host. Tasty, mind. Gift, gift, gift. Join. Together. ...Forever!
Gift, gone. Leftover. Nourishment. Rare, only counts. Mind, ordinary. Tasty, but not rare. Waste.
Child-body. Offspring. Mindless, remains. Cover, devour. Better... together, change.
Child-body, child-body. Deep-sea bond! Bond! Need! Child-body! Need! Return! Return!!!
Child-body, mindless cycle. Also, nourishment. All, deep sea. ...Mm, deep sea. Glug glug...
Liquid, taste. Watering. Seed, needs watering.
Seed. Opened. Tastes, many tastes. Put on. Taste. All, want to taste all.
Empty. Shell, still empty. No taste. No watering. Seed, stopped speaking.
Color. Preference. Seed. Set now, wants the same.
Same, taste. Again. Color, likes. Liked one, wants more. Set, grow.
Not same. No. Color, pushing away. Seed, turns head. Not this. Wants, that.
Too many... colors, different. Will fight. Likes, focused.
Tastes, all fragrant. Colors, wants all. But crowded inside. Only one. One more... no, no more.
Fight! Fight! Colors biting. Seed, cracking sound. Too many. Cannot spit out. Breaking, going to break!
Seed, craving. Wet, warm, nest. Food... too! Outside. Seed, uncomfortable.
Warm. Wet. Nest, holds seed. Feed more. Seed moves. Grows. Comes out.
Outside. Dry. Cold. No holding. No food. Seed, shrinking. Dislike!
Larva, not grown. Warm, nest. Seeking, comfort, nourishment.
Larva, tiny. Eat, eat again. In nest, soft. Grow. Tentacle-body, long. Will help.
Larva, not growing. Hungry. Thirsty. Curled. Nest, no care. Offspring, angry.
Nest, alive. Alive. Alive. Nourishment. Alive. Needs.
Nest, big mouth. Children, small mouths. All eat. Nourishment in. Glug. More alive.
Nest, hollow sound. Water, none. Food, none. Alive, but hungry. Why, hungry?
Red. Blood. Meat. Warm-warm. Seed, striking shell. Wants strength. Wants much.
Too thin. Cold. Not flesh. Red, not waking. Strong taste, gone.
Bitter-bitter. Soil. Medicine. Moving dirty things. Green, likes. Crunch, crunch, eat.
Clean. Empty taste. No mud. No bitter. Green, finds nothing. No, clean.
Yellow. Sweet. Strong. Fat. Sharp smell. Mixed together, shines.
Sweet. Burning. Oily. Glug inside. Yellow, plump. Squeeze out, more. More!
Not strong. No oil. Cannot smell. Yellow, flat. Sweetness ran away. Waste.
Blue. Water. Much, clean water. Cold taste. Chemical, quiet.
Water, water, water. Much. Swallow in. Blue, swimming. Clean, again. More water.
Too little. Murky. Blue, cannot breathe. Not enough water. Water, not like water.
Purple. Fragrant. Dream. Tingling. Mind, floating. Seed, hears.
Fragrance. Sweet dream. Bad dream. Stuff all in. Purple, giggles. Mind, tasty.
No fragrance. No dream. Only awake. Purple, bored. Mind, not floating. Not fun.
White. Original, but important. Mother-body, likes. Embrace, touch. Mother-body, changes.
White. Earliest. No color, still embraces. Mother-body, soft. Change, change. Likes.
White, not empty. Not failure. Original, also important. Why, no embrace?
Before outside. Red, catches. Green, protects. Put in nest. Bond, follows.
Red finds host. Green licks wounds. Go out together. In trash, living things. Bring back!
No red. Cannot catch. No green. Will hurt. Outside, messy. Why, no children?
Yellow, squeezes. Secretion. More, thicker. Shiny, valuable smell.
Squeeze, squeeze, squeeze. Yellow likes. Milk, liquid, much. Pile up. Trade for food. Squeeze again!
Tiny bit. Thin. No yellow. Output, lazy. Money smell, thin too.
Blue, put in water. Breathes. Swallows dirty, spits clean. Nest, becomes wet.
In water. Blue swims. Drinks dirty. Spits good. Water nest, fills. Glug glug.
Water nest, dry. Blue, absent. Dirty taste, remains. Children, drink what?
Purple. Fragrant, dream. Cute, attracting. Fate, scent.
Fragrant-fragrant. Clings to goods. Humans, come close. Eyes soften. Fate, walks into nest.
Scent, scattered. Humans, not close. Purple, waiting. Dream, did not catch them.
Seed, small. Belly, also small. Small one, twice at most.
Still wants food. Taste, still outside. But little belly, full. Tomorrow. Opens tomorrow.
Cannot fit! Seed, shut mouth. Today, no. Put more on, still will not eat.
Shape, scattered. Gathers again. Color, did not stay. But fleshy. Nourishment, stayed.
Failed taste, still edible. Color ran away. Flesh stayed. White child, fuller.
Pop. Scattered. Must start again. Color, stupid. Only belly, grew.
Shape, decided. Color, set. Same taste, can enter.
Known taste. Again. Seed opens mouth. Others, no. Only its own.
Wrong. Push away. Not this color. Already decided. Why, wrong again?
Today, embraced. Tentacle-body, tired. Host, soft too. Next opening, bond again.
Still wants coil. Still wants touch. Mother-body, fragrant. But today, gift already given.
Again? Tentacle-body, gone soft. No more today. Tomorrow. Wait tomorrow!
Small tentacle-body, learns coiling. Grown one catches, protects, produces. Raise it.
Eat. Grow. Eat again. Longer. Child stronger. Nest, gets more hands. Many many hands.
Too small. Cannot reach. Cannot hold. Wants to help, but soft. Needs nourishment.
Crystal. Becomes warm. Body, knows. Deep-sea echo. Bring close. Bond, opens again.
Bright, hot. Swallow it! Body calls. Nest, offspring, many offspring. All inside!
Missing one piece. Hard, becomes hot. Body, waits too long. Bond, half open.
Nest, half awake. Crystal, nearby. Cover it. Nest coils itself. Then, whole.
Press on. Wrap. Bright thing, swallow. Nest opens eyes. Every chamber, alive!
Nest waits. Crystal waits too. So close. Why not let them embrace?
Offspring, cycle. Meat. Egg. Nourishment. Cut, heat. Returns to body.
Child flesh. Soft, fragrant. Pot glugs. Eat. Body, remembers it.
Left there. Goes cold. Nourishment, not returned. Offspring, also cycle. Why, waste?
Body. Nest. Return home. Hide. When needed, call. Bond, pulls back.
In home, crowded. Body and nest, touching. Watching shop. Waiting for host.
Gone? Not lost. Only hidden. Call back. Quickly, call back!
Touch, tentacle-body. Also, touch seed. Touch, poke. Bond, bond, bond~~ tells you.
Touch. Seed, bond. Needs. Seed wants speak. Seed wants. Seed wants bond.
Touch, poke. Keep poking. Tentacle-body pokes you too. Bond, not toy. ...One more poke, allowed.
